stocks.businessDesc: Mondelez International, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells snack food and beverage products in Latin America, North America, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Europe.
First Solar, Inc., a solar technology company, provides photovoltaic (PV) solar energy solutions in the United States, France, India, Chile, and internationally.
Cloudflare, Inc. operates as a cloud services provider that delivers a range of services to businesses worldwide.
SK Telecom Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of wireless telecommunication services in South Korea.
Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America.
InfuSystem Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides infusion pumps and related products and services in the United States and Canada.
Roku, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a TV streaming platform in the United States and internationally.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. provides satellite-based broadband services in the United States, Ireland, Canada, and internationally.
Hudbay Minerals Inc., a diversified mining company, focuses on the exploration, development, operation, and optimization of properties in North and South America.
Logitech International S.A., through its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and markets software-enabled hardware solutions that connect people to working, creating, and gaming worldwide.

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., a financial institution, provides a range of financial services for corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
Kaiser Aluminum Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells semi-fabricated specialty aluminum mill products.
American Superconductor Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides megawatt-scale power resiliency solutions worldwide.

Argan, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, maintenance, project development, and technical consulting services to the power generation market in the United States, Republic of Ireland, and the United Kingdom.
Core Scientific, Inc. provides infrastructure for high-density colocation services and digital asset mining in the United States.
Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally.
Oscar Health, Inc. operates as a healthcare technology company in the United States.

Ouster, Inc. engages in the production and sale of lidar sensor kits for the automotive, industrial, robotics, and smart infrastructure industries in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
MDA Space Ltd. provides space technology solutions and services in Canada, the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and internationally.
IonQ, Inc. develops quantum computing systems in the United States, Switzerland, and Internationally.
Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
The Williams Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an energy infrastructure company primarily in the United States.

TechnipFMC plc engages in the oil and natural gas projects, technologies, systems, and services businesses in Europe, Central Asia, North America, Latin America, the Asia Pacific, Africa, the Middle East, and internationally.

CECO Environmental Corp. provides critical solutions in industrial air quality, industrial water treatment, and energy transition solutions in the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, China, and internationally.
Carpenter Technology Corporation engages in the manufacture, fabrication, and distribution of specialty metals in the United States, Europe, the Asia Pacific, Mexico, Canada, and internationally.
